item.title: Teen injured in shooting near Illinois State University
item.description: A 16-year-old girl was taken to the hospital after being shot in Normal, Illinois, and is currently in stable condition.

item.title: ​Nearly 250 students compete in IHSEA Super Smash Bros Invitational at Bradley University
item.description: Nearly 30 high schools from across Illinois gathered in Peoria for the IHSEA Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Invitational, where around 250 students competed in solo and crew battles to qualify for the IHSEA State Championship.

item.title: Kickabrew Coffee Company holds grand re-opening
item.description: After a fire caused by a buildup of chaff in the ventilation system, Kickabrew Coffee Company has reopened with a new roaster and an upgraded chaff collection system, and has received an overwhelming response from the community.

item.title: Semi driver arrested after police chase through multiple Central Illinois counties
item.description: The driver of a semitruck was taken into custody after leading police on a chase through multiple counties, ending when spike strips were deployed to flatten the tires and stop the vehicle.

item.title: Accidental stove fire in Peoria apartment displaces two women
item.description: A kitchen fire in a Peoria apartment caused an estimated $15,000 in damage and displaced two women, but no injuries were reported.

item.title: Jack in the Box Office: ‘Wuthering Heights’ Leads Packed Holiday Weekend
item.description: This weekend's box office is stacked with something for everyone, from the romance of 'Wuthering Heights' to the family animation of 'GOAT' and the thriller 'Crime 101', while 'Send Help' offers a unique survival twist.

item.title: Annual “Best of the Wurst” dinner celebrates German culture in Peoria
item.description: The German American Central Society held its annual "Best of the Wurst" dinner at the Lindenhof, featuring traditional German food, music, and fellowship, open to all who wish to learn about the German culture.

item.title: Train enthusiasts pack Illinois Central College for Peoria Train Fair
item.description: Train enthusiasts from across the region gathered at Illinois Central College for the Peoria Train Fair, showcasing detailed model railroads and shopping for memorabilia, with over 100 tables and 43 vendors in attendance.

item.title: Bradley University mourns loss of legendary coach Joe Stowell
item.description: Bradley University President James Shadid announced the death of beloved coach Joseph R. "Joe" Stowell, who had a long-lasting connection to the university and was the only coach to place both a men's and a women's player in the U.S. Olympic Trials.

item.title: McLean County man arrested for allegedly stabbing stepfather with knives
item.description: Matthew A. Mize was arrested after allegedly stabbing his stepfather with two steak knives, resulting in attempted murder and aggravated domestic battery charges.
